content.stem: 根据金融行动特别工作组（FATF）的《基于风险方法：人寿保险部门指南》，以下哪两项是涉及第三方参与人寿保险产品的洗钱警示信号？（选择两项。）

options.A: 一位客户聘请律师就保单签发事宜进行咨询
options.B: 客户将保单转让给与原保单签发公司无关联的另一家保险公司
options.C: 经常收到与保单持有人无明显关系的第三方支付款项
options.D: 客户指定一个显然不相关的第三方为受益人

content.stem_en: According to the Financial Action Task Force's (FATF's) Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach: Life Insurance Sector, which of the following are money laundering red flags relating to the involvement of a third party in a life insurance product? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: A customer engages an attorney to consult on the issuance of the policy
options_en.B: A customer transfers the policy to another insurance company unaffiliated with the original policy issuer
options_en.C: Payments are regularly received from third parties that have no apparent relationship with the policyholder
options_en.D: A customer names an apparently unrelated third party as a beneficiary
